examples.title: Build a basic RGB grade
examples.code:
# Create a Grade and adjust several controls together.
grade = nuke.createNode("Grade")
grade["channels"].setValue("rgb")
grade["multiply"].setValue([1.10, 1.05, 0.95, 1.0])
grade["gamma"].setValue([0.95, 0.95, 0.95, 1.0])

# Return the color controls to neutral values.
grade["multiply"].setValue([1.0, 1.0, 1.0, 1.0])
grade["gamma"].setValue([1.0, 1.0, 1.0, 1.0])

examples.title: Adjust all Grade nodes in a script
examples.code:
# Restrict every Grade node to RGB and raise its multiply value.
for grade in nuke.allNodes("Grade"):
    grade["channels"].setValue("rgb")
    grade["multiply"].setValue([1.1, 1.1, 1.1, 1.0])
